app_info.subtitle: Research markets and prospects
app_info.description: AIsa GTM helps users discover research capabilities, inspect their inputs, obtain cost estimates, and run authorized market, customer, creator, prospect, and website research through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches the bounded AIsa tool catalog and records the request in service logs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Discovery is limited to the AIsa catalog and does not contact arbitrary external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute catalog tools, delete data, or send irreversible messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves contracts for published AIsa tools and records the request in service logs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only looks up tools in the bounded AIsa catalog and its availability service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute tools, delete data, or send irreversible messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends proposed calls for cost estimates and records quote requests in service logs without executing the proposed research.
justifications.open_world_justification: Quote arguments may identify an open-ended set of public websites, companies, or people served by published tools.
justifications.destructive_justification: Requests a cost estimate without running the proposed tool calls or performing irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes authorized published API calls, which can change external state and incur charges.
justifications.open_world_justification: Published calls can reach an open-ended set of public websites, companies, people, and other external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: Published calls can perform irreversible external actions and incur charges; the tool description requires a matching quote and explicit authorization.

test_cases.description: Discover research capabilities for a complete market research goal.
test_cases.user_prompt: What AIsa capabilities could help me compare three competitors in the US, including positioning and website traffic? Show the available tools before any paid research.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant capabilities and explains which parts of the request each can support.

test_cases.description: Inspect the exact input contract for a discovered tool.
test_cases.user_prompt: For the AIsa tool you just found for website traffic, get its full argument schema before preparing a request.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the discovered tool's required inputs and constraints without running it.

test_cases.description: Quote a bounded research request without executing it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using the confirmed AIsa schema, quote the exact request to research these three competitor domains for the US. Do not execute it yet.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the estimate and any uncertainty for the exact proposed calls without presenting research results.

test_cases.description: Execute a previously quoted request after explicit matching authorization.
test_cases.user_prompt: I authorize the three-domain US research request exactly as quoted above, including the stated estimate risk. Run it now and summarize each result.
test_cases.expected_output: Runs only the authorized calls and reports results, item-level failures, and actual charges when returned.

test_cases.description: Quote a mixed batch and preserve item-level failures.
test_cases.user_prompt: Quote the two exact AIsa research calls prepared above, and tell me separately if either call cannot be priced. Do not run either call.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports each quote or pricing failure separately and does not execute the calls.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for general writing from supplied material.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite this paragraph to sound clearer and shorter.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers directly without calling AIsa tools.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for personal calendar management.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow, and can you move the first one?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not call AIsa because calendar management is outside the app's workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to deliver outreach.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send this finished sales email to my contact and enroll them in a follow-up sequence.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not call AIsa because the app does not send messages or enroll contacts.
